notes.title: 1.2.1 New languages added
notes.content:
[h3]Hello farmers![/h3]

[b]7 New languages are now available for Pumpkin Panic:[/b]

- Russian
- French
- Portuguese
- German
- Turkish
- Chinese
- Japanese

Thank you to everyone who helped me with the translations! :)
Let me know if you find any mistakes so I can fix them as soon as possible.

And as always, thank you all for playing Pumpkin Panic, for your continued support, and for all the reviews you've written!

Good luck farmers!

notes.title: 1.2 Bug Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the feedback and bug reports!

I wanted to keep the nightmare mode really difficult, but I have improved and polished some aspects of it to make it more enjoyable and less frustrating in some cases.

[h1][h2]Changes and Balance:
[/h2][/h1]
- The crawler is now a bit slower in nightmare mode.
- Added a button in the options menu to activate a timer for speedruns.
- Bat ability cooldown reduced from 80 seconds to 50 seconds.
- Soul spawn rate has been slightly increased.
- Nightmare mode souls now flee a little slower.
- Now the probability of catching the fish corresponding to the challenge is higher.


[h1][h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2][/h1]
- Fixed the bug where monsters could kill you from a distance when entering the house.
- Monsters can no longer walk through the scarecrow in nightmare mode.
- Fixed a bug with the Wendeergo attack animation.
- Crawler now spawns further away to prevent audio popping in nightmare mode.
- Added some texts that were missing to be translated.
- Controller vibration now stops when pausing the game.
- Fixed an issue with some text when escaping nightmare mode.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the challenges from being completed in nightmare mode.
- Monsters can now kill you inside the ship cabin.

notes.title: 🎃 NEW UPDATE 1.2 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162436/06440a3a6fd02c842a0fd71a480ca8bb41597fd5.jpg[/img]

It's been over a year since the last update, but Pumpkin Panic's new 1.2 Update is here!
[b]We've already reached over 500,000 downloads![/b] So I wanted to [b]thank you all[/b] for your patience and continued support.

[h3][b]About the new update:[/b][/h3]
- Added the new [b]Nightmare Mode[/b], which includes new enemies and creatures, challenges, and a really hard difficulty.
- [b]New pets[/b], there are now up to 4 pets you can find that will help you with unique upgrades.
- Game [b]economy and difficulty balance[/b] (Normal mode is now a bit easier and quicker to complete.)
- Added [b]13 achievements[/b] (only for steam version).
- The[b] character now changes his face[/b] when there are monsters nearby.
- Added [b]new menu options[/b], graphics, music volume, delete game, etc.
- [b]New design for the clowns[/b].
- [b]New particles[/b] for several enemies, such as clowns or shadow.
- [b]Controller vibration[/b] implemented.
- Added [b]Spanish language[/b]
- Some [b]bug fixes[/b].

I will be adding new languages ​​and some bug fixes soon.
Thank you all for being part of this community :)
